content:
maya: quick audit note: found two small issues on the runtime-config KB page while prepping onboarding material. low-risk but should be fixed before this week's hire batch.
sam: what'd you find?
maya: 1) curl example still points at the legacy host `api.redwood-inference.dev` (should be api.redwood-inference.com) 2) internal crosslink to the KV cache section targets `#kv-cache-v2` but the heading is now `KV cache (v3)` so the anchor is dead. page: https://kb.internal.redwood/runtime-config
juan: i'll take this one if no objections. quick PR + tiny test. assign to me.
maya: thanks — assigning to @juan. i'll draft a one-line QA in the PR description.
sam: can you paste the curl snippet here so I can confirm the replacement?
mayanote: here's what's rendered now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"hello"}'
```
suggested minimal change (host only):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"hello"}'
```
and change the crosslink target from `#kv-cache-v2` to `#kv-cache-v3`.
nate: small FYI — the onboarding quickstart repo (redwood/onboarding-scripts) also has the same example. if we flip this in the KB we should create an issue to sync the scripts, otherwise new hires will copy the old URL.
juan: good call. i'll update the docs page and leave a note in the PR linking the onboarding issue. plan: update host + anchor, add changelog entry and a one-line manual check: run `curl -I -H \"Dry-Run: true\" <endpoint>` to ensure no 404s. ETA ~90m.
pr-bot: PR created: branch `docs/fix/runtime-host-anchor` by juan. status: draft. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/812 (auto)
nate: created onboarding issue: https://github.com/redwood/onboarding-scripts/issues/42 (onboarding: update runtime example host) — i'll reference it in the docs PR.
maya: lovely — once PR is ready ping me and i'll merge + deploy. :thumbsup:
